From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>

Date: Fri, 1 Jun 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Candidate debrief - Platform Eng (Asha Patel) — heatmap sync & ratings lock

Hi team,

Thanks again for interviewing Asha yesterday. I pulled together an initial heatmap (attached) and started a consolidated scorecard (asha_scorecard_markus.xlsx) — please review and update your row by EOD Pacific. There are a couple of specific asks:

- Fill the numeric scores for System Design, Infra Ownership, and Communication (1-5).
- Add one short bullet (1-2 lines) for the strongest signal and one for risk/concern.
- If you want to raise a hard blocker, mark it with the word BLOCKER in the notes column.

I flagged a possible variance between System Design and Ownership — hoping we can converge quickly. If we have a >1 point spread on any axis, I propose we call a 15-min sync at 3pm to resolve.

Attachments: debrief_heatmap_v1.png (draft), asha_resume.pdf, asha_scorecard_markus.xlsx

Thanks — Markus

Markus Klein
Staff Eng Manager, Interviews & Hiring Ops
Redwood Inference
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>

Date: Fri, 1 Jun 2028 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Candidate debrief - Platform Eng (Asha Patel) — heatmap sync & ratings lock

Markus — thanks for taking the lead. I filled my row in the spreadsheet and attached a short exported PDF of my notes (laura_debrief_export.pdf). Quick summary:

- System Design: 4 (solid trade-offs on distributed caches; asked the right paranoia questions)
- Ownership: 3 (solid experience but lacked examples on long-lived incident ownership)
- Communication: 5 (clear and structured)

Strong signal: thoughtful capacity planning example for KV cache.
Concern: minimal exposure to multi-tenant isolation in production (teams I worked with had similar gaps).

I do not think this is a blocker but worth highlighting in hiring manager conversation. I can't make 3pm PT but happy to share notes in the 15-min sync if you run it without me.

—Laura
Laura Bennett
Senior SWE, Platform

"Design flowed logically, but missed key availability trade-offs for cross-region writes; follow-ups on throttling and cold-start behaviour were vague."

Subject: Re: Candidate debrief - Platform Eng (Asha Patel) — heatmap sync & ratings lock

Thanks all — reviewed the updated sheet. Two quick proposals to keep our debrief defensible and fast:

1) Tie-break rule: when spread >1 on System Design, we average the two nearest reviewers and let HM (Elena) weigh in with a final call within 24 hours.
2) For Ownership ambiguity, require a follow-up question: "Describe a time you owned a cross-service incident from detection to postmortem." If candidate can't give a structured example, treat Ownership <=3.

I've annotated the heatmap with colored tags (link below) and highlighted the System Design cells for Asha. If everyone agrees, I'll lock the numeric scores in the sheet and notify recruiting to push to HM.

Heatmap (annotated): https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1Xq-debrief-heatmap#gid=3

-Karthik
Senior PM, Platform Hiring Ops

Subject: Re: Candidate debrief - Platform Eng (Asha Patel) — heatmap sync & ratings lock

Thanks everyone — solid thread. Quick summary and next steps: 

- Current numeric spread on System Design = {Marissa:2, Laura:4, Markus:4} -> spread = 2.
- We will apply Karthik's tie-break rule. Karthik to average the two nearest (Laura + Markus -> 4) and pass to HM for final read.
- Marissa, we appreciate the concern; please paste your two-line follow-up question into the sheet under the "HM follow-up" column.
- I will lock the scores in the master sheet now and copy to recruiting.

Recruiting (cc'd): please route the locked scorecard to Elena Park and propose these next steps: HM quick call + optional 30-min technical follow-up if HM requests.

Attachments: asha_scorecard_final_locked.xlsx (locked export), debrief_heatmap_v1.png

If anyone wants the 3pm sync I proposed earlier, I still have that slot open for a short call — but since Karthik is doing the averaging, we can likely close async.

Thanks — Markus
